title: Adaptive frequency hopping anti-interference method, device and electronic equipment based on federated learning
assignee: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications

pse.problem: Communication systems face difficulties in maintaining quality due to complex electromagnetic environments and advanced interference technologies.
pse.solution_function: An adaptive frequency hopping strategy is determined based on the communication environment for each drone device within a flight self-organizing network system. The strategy is learned using federated learning, which involves training an initial dual deep Q network model by the drone devices and a base station, generating an aggregate network model, and performing secondary learning training on the dual deep Q network model.
pse.solution_structure: The solution consists of drone devices, each equipped with a dual deep Q network model, and a base station. The base station generates the aggregate network model.
pse.solution_implementation: Each drone device trains its initial dual deep Q network model based on interaction information between itself and the environment, which includes its own communication state, actions (carrier frequency selection), rewards, and new state information. The model parameters are uploaded to the base station, generating an aggregate network model using federated average algorithm. Each drone device receives the aggregate network model for secondary learning training.
pse.effect: The adaptive frequency hopping strategy provides versatility in diverse interference environments, improving the anti-interference ability and communication quality of the system.
